recipe.name: StenoDesk backend (FastAPI + Mongo)
recipe.notes: Tests are live-server suites (httpx against TEST_BASE_URL, default localhost:8001). Env required at start: MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, JWT_SECRET, FRONTEND_URL; POSTMARK_SERVER_TOKEN fake locally; DISABLE_SCHEDULER=1; POSTMARK_WEBHOOK_TOKEN + ADMIN_EMAILS(Support@stenodesk.co) for webhook/admin suites; STRIPE_* keys for billing round-trips. Stripe fail-closed tests auto-skip unless SERVER_STRIPE_KEY_PRESENT=1. Cookie tests need https (Secure cookies) - they skip on http.
